dishes.name: Smoked Pulled Pork Sandwich
dishes.description: Tender, slow-smoked pulled pork piled high on a soft, buttery brioche bun and topped with our homemade Blood Orange Honey Citrus Coleslaw. Smoky, juicy, sweet, and citrusy with the perfect fresh crunch—a RiseUp BBQ twist on a classic pulled pork sandwich.

dishes.name: Smoked tri-tip sandwich
dishes.description: Tender, smoked tri-tip piled high on a soft, buttery brioche bun, topped with our fresh homemade chimichurri and finished with RiseUp BBQ’s signature barbecue sauce. Smoky, juicy, savory, and packed with bold flavor in every bite.

dishes.name: Brisket Sandwich
dishes.description: Tender, slow-smoked brisket piled high on a soft, buttery brioche bun, topped with our fresh homemade chimichurri and finished with RiseUp BBQ’s signature barbecue sauce. Smoky, savory, and packed with bold flavor in every bite.

dishes.name: Cajun Mac and Cheese
dishes.description: Rich, creamy mac and cheese made with a blend of cheeses and seasoned with our Cajun-inspired spices. Smooth, cheesy, and full of bold Southern flavor—the perfect side to pair with our slow-smoked BBQ.

dishes.name: Collard Greens with Smoked Turkey
dishes.description: Slow-cooked collard greens made from scratch and loaded with tender meat from our house-smoked turkey legs. Seasoned with bold Southern flavors and simmered until perfectly tender for a rich, smoky, soulful side that pairs perfectly with our BBQ.

dishes.name: Nola Dirty Rice
dishes.description: A true taste of New Orleans, made from our family recipe passed down from my mama. Savory, perfectly seasoned rice prepared with traditional Creole flavors and the soulful taste of home. Authentic New Orleans comfort food made the way our family has been making it for years.
